# UPchieve Changelog, week of Sep 26 to Oct 5, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Oct 5, subway Oct 5. These deploys carried the SSO credential, non-US school, `adminUpdateUser`, PhotoDNA, and coach opt-in work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Let an applicant enter a school outside the US.** The "I can't find my school" form asks for a country, starting on the one in their profile, with a searchable picker. A US school still needs a state; anywhere else takes an optional state, province, or region. ([subway !2980](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2980), [high-line !1935](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1935)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let chapter admins give members a title.** Admins pick President, Vice President, Executive Board Member, or none from the row menu on the Members tab, their own title included, and making someone an admin asks for their title in the same step. President and Vice President need the admin role, so removing admin from either asks first, since they lose the title. Two presidents show as Co-President, the roster and CSV show each member's title, and a President can be top tutor now too. Every title a member is given is recorded in a `nths_group_member_title_histories` table, so we can look up later who held one. ([subway !2998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2998), [high-line !1944](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1944); history in [subway !2996](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2996)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🧪 **Keep the apply preview up past Sep 30, with the close date set in PostHog.** The preview hid itself once a date written into subway, Sep 30, had passed, which is also what broke high-line's e2e on main. The date comes from the `nths-application-page` flag payload now, set to Oct 15. The apply preview and application pages show it and drop the deadline once it is unset or past, with a bare date counting through the end of that day. The preview ([`nths-apply-preview-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/894044)) and the application page ([`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343)) both reach every coach, with subway's eligibility service deciding who actually sees either one. ([subway !2995](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2995), [high-line !1943](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1943)) *Ben Wheeler*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- **Let a coach choose what a student sees about them.** The opt-in was an experiment; this makes it a feature. 🚀 the fields a coach picks are stored as an array on `volunteer_profiles`, so total hours, sessions, students helped, and occupation stay read from where they already live ([subway !2938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2938)); 👀 the subway query that reads and writes that array ([subway !2939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2939)); ✅ high-line getting and storing the choice through it instead of passing the information over sockets ([high-line !1901](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1901)); ✅ a tutor info card shown to students and previewed by coaches ([high-line !1902](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1902)); ✅ the card on the student session view, collapsed to start so opening it can be counted ([high-line !1903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1903)); ✅ the dashboard modal redesigned and shown once, with clicking outside it storing an empty array, and coaches who saw it during the experiment seeing it again ([high-line !1904](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1904)); ✅ the card added to background info in Edit Profile, where a coach can change their answer, and the feature flag removed ([high-line !1905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1905)); 👀 tests on both sides ([subway !2944](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2944), [high-line !1911](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1911)). *Liseidy Bueno*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- **Trust only what the SSO provider returns:** 🚀 a signup is marked verified only on federated credentials that came back from SSO, not ones sent in the request, and the two now travel as separate arguments ([subway !2970](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2970)); ✅ Clever and ClassLink sign-in check an OAuth2 `state` token, closing a login CSRF where an attacker could get a victim signed into the attacker's account, and a student who starts from Clever or ClassLink, with no token saved yet, is sent back through the flow from our side so one can be added ([subway !2999](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2999)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Log why Socket.IO disconnected on a transport error.** On Oct 3, and on Sep 5, PagerDuty paged for subway's error rate, both times one browser stuck in a socket reconnect loop, and the disconnect log only said `transport error`. It carries the Engine.IO cause now: `overlap from client`, `poll connection closed prematurely`, or `write error`. ([subway !3000](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3000)) *Chris*
- **Hold America Counts tutors back as a backstop, so volunteers get to sessions first:** ✅ instead of auto-joining an eligible session right away, they wait until the request is about three minutes old, with the wait read from a new `america-counts-auto-join-delay` flag payload and defaulting to three minutes ([high-line !1939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1939)); 👀 federal work study (`fws`) tutors auto-join the same way, without grade-level or sub-topic requirements ([high-line !1940](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1940)). *sammy nave*
- ✅ **Rename `RoleContext.legacyRole` to `originalRole`,** following review feedback on [subway !2982](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2982). ([subway !2990](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2990)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Check an OAuth2 `state` token on Clever and ClassLink sign-in** reached production on Sep 28 and was reverted on Oct 1, because students signing in directly from Clever hit an error. ([subway !2979](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2979), reverted in [subway !2997](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2997)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- **Take a student or coach who missed the end of a session to the review instead of an error.** A student who refreshed after their coach ended the session landed on the dashboard and could not rate it. 🚀 subway registers every socket handler before setting up the connection, so a `sessions:join` sent right after connecting or reconnecting is no longer dropped until the client retries, and a refused join no longer clears a different session the socket joined in the meantime ([subway !2991](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2991)); 🚀 a join refused because the session ended carries `code: SESSION_ENDED` for the session's own student and coach, on both the HTTP join and the `sessions:join` reply ([subway !2993](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2993)); ✅ high-line uses it: a participant whose page missed the end sees the ended screen in place when the connection comes back, or lands on the review (the dashboard when the partner never took part) after a reload or reopened tab, and End and Finish replace history, so Back from the review no longer reloads the ended session ([high-line !1941](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1941)). 🐛 [#733](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/733) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Stop PhotoDNA errors from turning into failed uploads and false matches:** ID photos over 4 MB are stopped before upload, checked when picked and again after conversion, which can grow them, with a message saying the photo is too large, and subway turns them away too ([subway !2981](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2981), [high-line !1936](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1936)); the upload modal gives the limit as 4 MB rather than 25 MB ([high-line !1951](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1951)); a failed or malformed PhotoDNA response returns a 503 instead of being reported as a match, match details are saved as JSON instead of `[object Object]`, and database or quarantine-upload failures keep their own errors instead of becoming a `PhotoDnaMatchError` ([subway !2983](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2983)); ID photos in a format PhotoDNA can't read are turned away with a message listing the ones it can: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, or TIFF ([subway !2984](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2984)). A volunteer uploading their ID kept getting an error telling them to contact support. PhotoDNA screening ([`photodna-match-check`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/853470)) was switched off on Sep 15 and switched back on for everyone on Oct 5, once these were live. 🐛 [#726](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/726) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Let a teacher assign students to an assignment created without any.** Editing it failed with `studentsToRemove is null`, because the assignments query returned `studentIds: [null]` for an assignment with no students. The nulls are filtered out now. Found while checking the fix for the original report. 🐛 [#729](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/729) ([subway !2988](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2988)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Limit a session's recap messages to its student, its coach, and that student's teachers.** `POST /session/recap-dms` returned a session's messages to anyone signed in who sent its id. It uses the recap page's access check now. ([subway !2992](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2992)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Answer with a 500 right away when a route throws something that is not an `Error`.** `resError` set the status but never sent a response, so the request waited out the 30-second timeout and came back as a 504. ([subway !2994](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2994)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let a fresh local database start again.** [subway !2938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2938) brought in `db_init` files from a newer `pg_dump` carrying `SET transaction_timeout = 0`, a Postgres 17 setting; we run 15, so a fresh database failed with `unrecognized configuration parameter`. ([subway !2985](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2985)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Clean up the Docker volumes `test:database` leaves behind.** Every run created a freshly seeded database and left two anonymous volumes behind, until there was no memory left to create a worktree. `docker compose down` takes `-v` in the test setup and teardown now. ([subway !2989](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2989)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Restore test spies automatically between high-line tests.** Vitest's `restoreMocks` is on, so a `vi.spyOn` spy can no longer leak into the next test, and the per-spec `vi.restoreAllMocks()` and `.mockRestore()` calls it replaces are gone. ([high-line !1942](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1942)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Convert a coach's availability between time zones in the right direction.** The Moment to Day.js migration swapped `moment.tz.zone(...).parse()` for `dayjs.tz(...).utcOffset()`, which returns the offset with the opposite sign, so 2 pm PT was saved as 11 am ET instead of 5 pm ET and the coach was texted at 8 am PT. Loading the calendar shifted it back the other way, so it still showed 2 pm. It goes out together with a migration that fixes the schedules already saved wrong. 🐛 [#728](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/728) ([high-line !1938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1938)) *Trey Stevens*
- ✅ **Split high-line's dependencies into separate chunks again.** The build had been putting every dependency into one giant `.pnpm-<guid>` chunk. The fix made after the pnpm update ([high-line !1659](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1659)) was reverted at some point and never re-applied. ([high-line !1945](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1945)) *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Let high-line's e2e job run against a given subway commit.** It takes an optional `SUBWAY_REF`, and skips jobs like the high-line staging deploy when subway's pipeline starts it. It comes first so subway can run the e2e tests and block merges on the results. ([high-line !1946](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1946)) *Jamie Kasulis*

### Internal tools

- 🚀 **Let admins save changes to a student-volunteer with a partner org.** An admin trying to lift a student's ban could not save it. `adminUpdateUser` matched the partner org against the account's current role instead of its original one, which is the role a partner org belongs to today. 🐛 [#724](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/724) ([subway !2982](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2982)) *Jamie Kasulis*
